model: service-centre digital twin (DES with abandonment, hourly staffing)
purpose: Recommend agents per hour (08:00-20:00) so that >= 80% of calls are answered within 1 minute and <= 5% abandon.
intended_use: Daily staffing plan plus intraday re-plan when the live demand twin raises a drift alarm; advisory - the duty manager signs off.
assumptions: Poisson arrivals, rate constant within an hour
one skill, one FIFO queue, no callbacks or retrials
hour-by-hour staffing approximation, checked by full-day simulation
limitations: Patience is weakly identified (flat calibration error from about 3 to 5.5 min); peak service level is insensitive to it (elasticity about -0.04)
Rates above 5.6 calls/min were never observed: such plans carry a review flag
